description: A priced offer for a product: a per-unit money amount plus an optional minimal recurring-billing shape. Deliberately thin -- no tiers, no usage-based pricing, no proration; those are richer pricing models than a single price object can express and are explicitly deferred out of this launch catalog. Absence of recurring means the price is one-time. productId is optional because a price can be drafted standalone before being attached to a product, or embedded under a product the consumer already keys by its own id.

$kind.description: Optional self-identifier (cf. GraphQL __typename). Omit when the enclosing schema already names the role -- a value held under a property literally named price is unambiguously a price without needing $kind. Include only when this object might appear untyped outside its normal context.

externalReferences.description: Links to corresponding records in foreign systems, e.g. Stripe or Shopify -- see external-reference for shape and validation. Replaces ad-hoc *Id fields scattered across schemas with one uniform array.

metadata.description: Freeform escape hatch for consumer-specific data this schema doesn't model. Deliberately non-interoperable -- a private extension zone, not part of the typed interop surface. Recommend reverse-DNS-style keys (e.g. "com.example.internalId") when multiple parties write to it.

productId.description: Opaque id of the product this price offers, keyed in the consumer's own catalog (see commerce.product). Optional -- a price may be drafted standalone before being attached to a product, or embedded under a product the consumer already keys by its own id.

recurring.description: Minimal recurring-billing shape: an interval and how many of them make one billing period (e.g. every 2 weeks). Absence of this property on the price means the price is one-time, not recurring. Deliberately stops here -- no usage-based pricing, no tiers, no proration; those need richer modeling than a single price object can carry and are deferred to a future schema version if/when they're needed.

intervalCount.description: How many intervals make one billing period, e.g. 2 with interval "week" for billing every 2 weeks. Absent means 1.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the price. Absent means active. archived retires the price from new use without invalidating historical references to it in line items, invoices, etc.

unitAmount.description: Per-unit price. $ref money -- never an inline number (see money's description for why: exact integer minor-unit arithmetic, no float error). Constrained to non-negative via the sibling properties/amount/minimum below, composed alongside the $ref (legal in draft 2020-12) -- catalog prices are non-negative; negative adjustments are not prices.

title: Price
